lessons.observation: Individually valid receipts can still conflict, replay, or span incompatible environments when reviewed as a set.
lessons.what_worked_or_failed: Exact single-receipt validation worked; batch consistency was not represented.
lessons.root_cause_or_enabling_factor: No batch digest, component uniqueness, replay set, environment policy, or all-or-nothing transaction preview existed.
lessons.test_or_evidence_that_revealed_it: NEXT_VERSION_IMPROVEMENT_LIST live-evidence-provider-adapters and unified operations obligations.
lessons.product_change_made: Added batch reconciliation and deterministic promotion transaction preview.
lessons.builder_prompt_system_change_made: Added conflict, replay, mixed-environment, tamper, and partial-batch tests.
lessons.future_candidate_selection_effect: Prefer evidence workflows that validate the whole decision set, not isolated records.
lessons.future_testing_or_recovery_effect: Recovery must preserve batch digest, uniqueness, ordering, and no-mutation boundaries.

lessons.observation: Keeping final identity outside the ZIP avoids self-reference but manual reporting can still drift from embedded candidate and source evidence.
lessons.what_worked_or_failed: The boundary was correct; deterministic detached generation and comparison were missing.
lessons.root_cause_or_enabling_factor: Packaging and reporting were separate operator steps without a shared verifier.
lessons.builder_prompt_system_change_made: Added post-package twin comparison and seventeen-field cross-receipt validation.
lessons.future_candidate_selection_effect: Prefer release automation that preserves non-circularity while reducing manual identity reconciliation.
lessons.future_testing_or_recovery_effect: Final delivery must always produce and validate a detached receipt after immutable packaging.

unresolved_learning_questions: Which exact GitHub repository and Render service are canonical?
What authenticated owner transaction should apply a valid evidence batch without creating hidden deployment authority?
next_version_learning_priorities: Detached receipt publication beside immutable artifact
